source: This is a structured workspace, not customer research. It does not interview people, infer customer behavior or generate evidence. source: This describes the data you provide; it does not train or validate a model. AUC alone does not show calibration, fairness, clinical usefulness or performance on new data. Do not use a single metric to make high-stakes decisions. Nothing is uploaded.
